title: One Who Works For What He Eats,
summary: Seva is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: One who calls himself a guru or a spiritual teacher, while he; one who works for what he eats, and gives some of what
lifeApplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.coreClaim: One who calls himself a guru or a spiritual teacher, while he; one who works for what he eats, and gives some of what
evidence.turn: The path is not performed through appearance. It is walked through honest labor and giving.
